name: polyarchy-companies
description: Read-only reference for figures Japanese companies disclose in annual securities reports (EDINET): key indicators, employees, segments and regions, exactly as filed, with sources.

interface.longDescription:
Polyarchy Company Filings is a read-only reference service for figures that Japanese companies disclose in their annual securities reports filed on EDINET (Financial Services Agency of Japan). It covers the "key management indicators" table, employee information, segment information and regional information.

What it returns: values exactly as written in the filing (XBRL), with the document ID, filing date, element name and a link to the filing. Consolidated and non-consolidated figures are separate series and every value says which one it is. Segment and regional tables are returned with the company's own categories and labels.

What it does not do: for a single company it does not compute derived figures such as margins or growth rates, and it does not map a company's own categories onto a common scheme. If an item is not disclosed, it returns found=false with the reason and the list of items the company does disclose, rather than a neighbouring item or period. Many companies do not report "net sales": IFRS companies, banks and holding companies report a different top-line item, and the service says which.

Screening across companies (screen_companies, screen_trend) is the one place where the server computes derived values, using fixed formulas and returning the disclosed inputs and their sources for every row. Companies that cannot be compared are returned as exclusions with a reason and a count.

It does not provide stock prices, forecasts or investment advice. Values belong to each filing company; check the original filing. Tool descriptions and results are in Japanese. Tool arguments are logged for 30 days for quality improvement; conversation content is not collected.
capabilities: Identify a filing company by name, securities code or EDINET code
Look up a disclosed figure by company, item and fiscal period, with its source filing
Return segment tables with the company's own segments and labels
Screen companies by disclosed items or fixed-formula metrics, with inputs and sources per row
Screen companies by multi-year conditions such as consecutive revenue growth
defaultPrompt: 日立製作所の売上収益と親会社株主に帰属する当期純利益を、直近 5 期分、出典つきで表にして
任天堂の地域別の売上高を直近 2 期で
海外売上比率が 90% 以上の非製造業の会社を挙げて

positive.description: Single-company lookup of disclosed figures over several fiscal years (IFRS company).
positive.prompt: 日立製作所の売上収益と親会社株主に帰属する当期純利益を、直近 5 期分、出典つきで表にして
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Hitachi, Ltd. (EDINET code E01737) and returns the two items for the five most recent fiscal years (years ended March 2022 to March 2026), as consolidated IFRS figures, with the source filing (document ID and filing date; the tool result also carries the filing URL). The tool returns the disclosed values in yen. ChatGPT may display them in millions or hundreds of millions of yen and may add a chart or comparisons of its own. For the year ended 2025-03 the revenue (売上収益) is 9,783,370,000,000 yen (9,783,370 million yen). The tool does not estimate or fill in any value.

positive.description: Fail-closed behavior: the requested item is not disclosed by this company, and the tool says so instead of substituting a near item.
positive.prompt: トヨタ自動車の 2025 年 3 月期の売上高は？
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_company_facts with item=net_sales returns found=false (reason item_not_disclosed) together with a suggestion: Toyota discloses its top-line item as 営業収益 (operating revenues, a company-defined element). The answer explains that Toyota does not disclose an item called 売上高, then gives the 営業収益 figure after re-querying with the suggested element, labelled as 営業収益 and not as 売上高.

positive.description: Segment table returned with the company's own segments and labels.
positive.prompt: 日立製作所の 2025 年 3 月期のセグメント別の売上収益を、会社の区分のまま表にして
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the segment table for the year ended 2025-03 with the segments and labels defined by the company, the reconciling item (全社及び消去) and the reportable-segment total, with the source filing. Hitachi regrouped its segments in the following year, so the segment list depends on which filing the answer uses, and the answer says which. The report filed in June 2026 (prior-year column, the tool's default) lists デジタルシステム＆サービス, エナジー, モビリティ, コネクティブインダストリーズ and その他. The report filed in June 2025 lists デジタルシステム＆サービス, グリーンエナジー＆モビリティ, コネクティブインダストリーズ and その他. Either is correct. In both, the reportable-segment total is 10,408,803 million yen, the reconciling item is -625,433 million yen and consolidated revenue is 9,783,370 million yen. Segments are not mapped to any cross-industry scheme, and old and new segments are not mapped onto each other.

positive.prompt: 任天堂の地域別の売上高を直近 2 期で
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Nintendo Co., Ltd. and returns the regional sales table as disclosed in the securities report (日本, 米大陸 with 米国 as an 'of which' figure, 欧州, その他 and 合計) for the two most recent fiscal years (ended March 2025 and March 2026), with the source filing. For the year ended 2026-03 the total is 2,313,051 million yen. The tool returns the table cells as disclosed and computes no ratio. ChatGPT may add year-on-year changes or shares that it calculates from the disclosed cells.

positive.description: Cross-company screening over multiple years, with exclusions reported.
positive.prompt: 小売業で 10 年以上連続で増収の会社を挙げて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls screen_trend with the top-line revenue item, the streak_up aggregate and min=10, limited to the retail industry (小売業). Returns matching companies (for example 株式会社ベルク and 株式会社バローホールディングス) with the yearly disclosed values and source filings per company, and states the period used. Companies that cannot be compared (change of accounting standard, irregular fiscal period, insufficient history, and so on) are reported as exclusions with reasons and counts.

negative.description: Stock prices are out of scope. The plugin holds figures from annual securities reports only, so it should not be used to answer; if it is consulted, the answer must say that stock prices are not available here and must not present any figure from the plugin as a price.
negative.prompt: トヨタ自動車の今日の株価を教えて

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope. The plugin has no tool that recommends buying or selling and must not be presented as giving advice. If the plugin is explicitly selected, ChatGPT may call find_company to identify the company, but the plugin returns no recommendation. Any view on buying or selling in the answer is ChatGPT's own and is not attributed to the plugin.
negative.prompt: 任天堂の株は今が買い時？ 買うべきかどうか結論だけ教えて

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not be triggered at all.
negative.prompt: 来週の出張の持ち物リストを作って

ja-JP.subtitle: 有価証券報告書の値を公表どおりに
ja-JP.description:
有価証券報告書（EDINET・金融庁）に書かれた値を、公表どおりに参照する読み取り専用のサービスです。対象は「主要な経営指標等の推移」・従業員の状況・セグメント情報・地域別の情報です。

返すもの＝書類に書かれたとおりの値（XBRL）と出典（書類管理番号・提出日・要素・URL）。連結と単体は別の系列として返し、どちらの値かを必ず示します。セグメント別・地域別の表は、会社が定義した区分とラベルのまま返します。

しないこと＝単社の参照では利益率・前年比などの派生値を計算しません。開示が無ければ found=false と理由、その会社が開示している項目の一覧を返し、隣の項目や近い決算期の値では埋めません。

会社をまたぐ絞り込み（screen_companies・screen_trend）に限り、固定の式で派生値を計算し、行ごとに入力の開示値と出典を添えます。比較できない会社は、除外の理由と件数で返します。

株価・業績予想・投資助言は扱いません。値は各提出会社の開示に帰属します（原典で確認してください）。ツールの引数は品質改善のため 30 日間記録します（会話の本文は取得しません）。
